author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Rate curve fixture (Story 2.6): 120 s. Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at a theta rate that cycles over 2 to 6 Hz every 60 s (center 4 Hz, swing 2 Hz, start phase 0 degrees), 75 percent AM depth. Gamma PAC layer: a 250 Hz sine carrier amplitude-modulated at a gamma rate that cycles over 30 to 60 Hz every 60 s (center 45 Hz, swing 15 Hz, start phase 0 degrees), its AM depth a smooth swell peaking at the 0 degree coupling phase of the curved theta reference, 100 percent. Both the same in both channels; together they can peak near 2.0, so the 24-bit WAV can clip. Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
